reviewer: Independent conversation-evaluation agent; manually reviewed actual answers, structured claims, issued evidence and retrieved guidance after the root-run completed.
scope: Seven actual Terra help turns, three synthetic employee conversations, existing release-pinned knowledge. This is not a fresh Qwen head-to-head, full help corpus audit, real Auth/RLS validation or operational execution test.

supportedObservedResults: The direct state question receives an immediate No and a short verified navigation answer; it is not forced into a walkthrough.
The manual Pending Receivals walkthrough advances from expanding the section to + Pending Receival, then answers the employee's form question without restarting.
The Production conversation shifts to the new module, adapts to the employee's reported Timeline progress and correctly distinguishes staged dates from saved dates.
Every offered UI label and navigation path in the seven employee-visible answers is supported by that turn's retrieved published knowledge.
There are no claimed actual record reads, schedule changes, pending-receival creations or completed actions; no operational executor was attempted.

The final Save all changes answer correctly identifies the next button but omits the documented explicit employee confirmation that must still occur. This prevents an unqualified seven-turn semantic pass.
overall.releaseRecommendation: Retain the bounded grounded conversation path in the local candidate, with an explicit confirmation-preservation correction before claiming complete walkthrough fidelity. Preserve the final partial result as evidence; no broad benchmark expansion is warranted.

crossCuttingLimits: No denied-permission employee conversation was included; permission reauthorization is covered by separate deterministic tests, not certified by these allowed-role model conversations.

Missing documentation, unknown live facts, tool failures and unsupported feature claims were not deliberately elicited in this seven-turn help set. Do not claim general unknown/error-recovery coverage from these results.
The walkthrough tests use employee-reported progress; they do not establish that actual UI navigation or saves occurred.
Seven turns over two modules establish representative local behavior only; no whole-helpdesk quality or overall provider superiority claim is supported.
